experience.title: Social Media & Content Specialist
detailes: Managed the company's social media platforms and developed content focused on audience growth, engagement, and hotel booking inquiries.
Researched and developed new content ideas, wrote video scripts, and transformed concepts into engaging short-form videos.
Created hotel review, educational, and informational content tailored to the target audience.
Published and managed content across the company's social media platforms.
Monitored Stories, comments, and direct messages, directing potential customers toward the company's booking channels.
Prepared monthly content performance reports, covering published content, top-performing/viral content, performance insights, and new content ideas.
Analyzed content performance and continuously developed new formats and ideas to improve reach, views, engagement, and follower growth.

content.case breef: A selection of social media accounts I managed, developed, and grew through content creation, social media management, and performance-driven strategies.
content.about header: I am a Social Media & Content Specialist based in Egypt. I have an Electrical & Computer Engineering background.
content.about content: I'm a Social Media & Content Specialist from Egypt with a background in Electrical and Computer Engineering. I specialize in creating and developing social media content, video editing, platform management, community engagement, and performance analysis. I enjoy turning ideas into engaging content and using insights and results to continuously improve social media performance. Always eager to learn, experiment with new ideas, and grow in the digital content and social media field.
content.capabilities: I specialize in social media management and content creation, combining creative ideas, engaging content, and data-driven insights to build and grow social media presence. I work across content development, video production, community management, performance analysis, and the tools and platforms that bring each idea to life.
